sentences: Electron tunneling spectroscopy on monolayer WSe2 gives a quasiparticle gap of 2.56 eV.
Optical spectroscopy gives a WSe2 optical gap of 1.724 eV.
The exciton binding energy for monolayer WSe2 is 0.82 eV.
Monolayer MoSe2 has an optical gap of 1.638 eV.
origin: Published result paraphrase, Nature Communications (2019), Results, monolayer WSe2/MoSe2
